name: Bateel Date Gift Box
about: A gift box of premium Emirati dates, a classic UAE present for family and friends. Dates are deeply rooted in local hospitality.
tip: Stuffed varieties cost more than plain dates, so choose based on your budget.

name: Arabic Attar Perfume Oil
about: A concentrated, alcohol-free perfume oil. Attar is a long-standing Gulf tradition, and this one is a blended scent.
tip: Smell a few samples first and choose the one you like before buying.
